evidence.observation: Pressure rising monotonically during growth from 3.02 to 3.49 Torr while Ar flow steady ~99-100 sccm and T at setpoint
MFC flow stable at setpoint, so pressure rise is not from increased input flow
O2 remains low (~4-6 ppm), no evidence of air ingress/seal leak

args.missing_evidence: Continued pressure trend and response to a brief Ar flow step-down (or pump/valve position readback) would confirm a growing downstream restriction versus a gauge drift.
